Bodh Gaya: Exploring the Serene Tibetan Temple! (Gaden Phelgayling)
Discover the Serene Beauty of Bodh Gaya's Tibetan Temple! A Travel Vlog Inside Gaden Phelgayling!
Come along on my travel adventure to Gaya, Bihar, as I explore the peaceful and culturally rich Gaden Phelgayling Namgyal Datsang (Tibetan Monastery)! Just a stone's throw from the sacred Mahabodhi Temple, this beautiful monastery offers a fascinating glimpse into Tibetan Buddhism in the heart of India's enlightenment capital.
